speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The door. I was first. I am saying first before anybody makes it a walk.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You were first at running. The boats are in my hands, which is the part I am keeping.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the hands, and then on the step. We are not a procession in the passage.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Joan has the door. Let her have the first word of the house. We have had the road.
